lines.en: Meanwhile...deep within the beating heart of Kumon-mi...
: I sincerely apologize for being away for so long!
: And also for maybe saying a few things about how I would take your organs!
: Please let me work here again! I need money!
: Ami, calm down! You don’t need to bow! It’s okay! We didn’t hire anyone in your place!
: No, but we probably should have. She’s been gone for months and the customers have barely even noticed.
: That’s only because Uta is super good at her job and steals all of the regular customers! But you’re right! I don’t deserve to be here anymore!
: Chika, come on. Ami’s technically your senpai, you know. And she’s been going through a really tough time lately. We need to be understanding in her time of need.
: For example, when my grandpa was dying of brain cancer-

: Blah, blah, blah. My mom died too and you don’t see me using that as an anecdote to explain away all of the times I’ve had to stick up for Yumi. Save the dead grandpa card for when it’s needed or it’ll lose its impact.
: I don’t mind if Ami comes back. She can handle some of the cooking again since I had to pick up the slack for her.
: Of course! I’ll do anything!
: Really? Then surrender Sensei to me. Platonically, of course. I just don’t feel comfortable with him being in the hands of a psychopath.
: You too? Really?
: I will do almost anything! Sensei has to stay with me or we’ll both burst into flames! It’s part of the Arakawa family curse!
: I would like to exercise my seniority here to remind Chika that she’s still technically the newest employee. Even if she has managed to build up a bit of a following in Ami’s absence.
: Wait, really? How? I’ve been here way longer and no one’s ever asked for me who I’m not already friends or relatives with.
: What can I say? I’m just better than you. It’s as simple as that.
: It’s not as simple as that. Chika caters to two demographics at once between her being half-Filipino and also a gyaru.
: Former gyaru mostly. I’m a cool rocker chick now.
: And also, since you sucked at being tsundere, you were checking the same boxes that I check but at a much lower rate. You’ll never steal cute-type customers away from Uta-chan. That’s impossible.
: Well...what am I supposed to do now? Because I can’t put myself in twintails anymore and Osako already caters to the customers looking for a boyish maid.
: Hey!
: We just need to reinvent you!
: Or you could find another job. Les Vetements might be hiring a replacement for me soon if they’re still there after the mall is finished being renovated.
: Ignore Chika. She’s just upset that she won’t be able to cover your shifts anymore and is going to slip back into poverty.
: Hey!
: It doesn’t matter who you are or what you want to be, Ami. What matters is that you’re back. We can figure out your new archetype over your next few shifts.
: But for now — we’ve got a show to run, ladies! Fix your clothes! Fix your makeup! Then get on out there and show our guests a good time!
: Just not that kind of good time because this isn’t that kind of place!
: Fine. But Ami’s SOL if she didn’t bring her uniform with her since we don’t have any extras.
: She’s not gonna work today anyway. I’ll have her start again next weekend or something.
: For now, just let me go over some of the stuff that’s changed with her while she’s been gone and I’ll get back with you and Osako-chan in a sec. Think you can hold down the fort?
: I’m sure we can figure it out.
: Come on, Osako-chan. Let’s leave Uta alone with the gremlin and hope that she isn’t eaten alive.
: There isn’t going to be any sort of drama in here from now on, is there? Because I’ve kind of enjoyed how peaceful things have been lately.
: Beats me. Ami’s the one you want to ask.
: That’s Ami-chan to you!
: Not while she’s not in unifoooooorm!~
: Out! Be gone! Vanish!
: Thanks a lot for sticking up for me, Uta...
: You really didn’t have to do that after I was so mean to you when you...well...broke into my house...
: Relax! And let’s not talk about anything either one of us may have done that may or may not have been illegal!
: I’m glad you’re back, Ami. I like your hair.
: Do you really? Sana’s mom did it when we were camping the other day. You don’t think it’s a little too masculine?
: Maybe a little bit, but I think you can pull it off. And I’m not just saying that because no one would be able to tell that you’re a girl from fifteen to twenty feet away.
: Please don’t remind me. I’m dealing with enough as-is right now. The last thing I need is even more breast envy.
: Don’t feel bad! Mine were small once too!
: But I guess you already know that since you saw my pictures in Sensei’s phone!
: Ahh, crap.
: Mhm. We’re gonna talk about this now.
: I know...I completely forgot about those until you said something.
: That’s perfectly fine! Because I’ve been waiting a really long time for you to not be completely miserable so I can tell you all about how that made me feel!
: Nothing has changed here while I’ve been gone, has it?
: We have a new parfait. Orientation done. Now, about those pictures!
: What do you want to know? You’ve always been nice to me, so I have no reason to lie to you.
: How many were there? What was I doing in them? Did he send them to anyone else? Are there copies? Does he still have them? Did you delete them? Did he say anything about them?
: Do you have a preference on...which one of those I answer first?
: Maybe answer this one instead and we can go from there.
: What kind of girl do you think I am, Ami?
: What kind of...girl?...
: Yeah.
: Like, I’m sure you think I sent that stuff to him, don’t you? Which would mean you think I’m probably a desperate whore or something along those lines, right?
: I don’t know how he got them...but I can tell you weren’t the one who sent them based on how you’re reacting to this.
: What kind of girl do you think I am, Ami? Answer the question.
: You really do think I’m just a thirsty slut, huh?
: Because I am.
: I took all sorts of pictures like that when I was younger, you know. Sent them to tons of guys...didn’t even get anything in return most of the time, but I was okay with that.
: Doing those things made me feel wanted. They made me feel pretty.
: And I was still learning how my body worked, so I did tons of self-exploring back then, if you catch my drift.
: Uta...
: And I mean tons. Several times a day. It was kind of like an addiction. But I’m sure you know how it is, right?
: I’m sure you got a little too handsy with yourself once you realized how to make yourself feel good. Right?...
: Not much has changed on that end, to be honest.
: I still do it all the time. Still spend way too many hours with my mind in the gutter.
: But you know, Ami?...That’s exactly where I belong.
: I can’t even make a guess about how many guys must have jerked off to me when I was growing up. But I’m sure it’s a lot since those pictures have been following me everywhere.
: That’s why I really moved, you know? Taking care of my grandpa was just a thing I also happened to do when I got here.
: But I wouldn’t be here at all if I wasn’t a needy, naughty girl who sought attention from the wrong people.
: One of them wound up stalking me. I guess the Internet wasn’t enough and he wanted a taste of the real thing.
: But that didn’t last long since my brother caught wind of it and attacked him before he could lay his hands on me.
: You think I would have done it, Ami?
: You think I would have let some old guy fuck me back then?
: I don’t know, Uta...
: Me either.
: And that’s what’s so fucking scary about it.
: Even now...even though it terrifies me...makes me nauseous...and quite literally makes my life borderline unlivable sometimes, I still don’t know.
: Part of me still gets excited thinking about that stuff. But then part of me wants to throw up and it all cancels out.
: You don’t think Sensei is...sending your pictures around, do you?...
: Probably not. But if there’s anything I know about older guys — and again, I know a lot — it’s definitely safe to say he’s jerking off to them. And I know how that makes me feel...
: But how does it make you feel? How has it changed the way you look at him? And how are you going to look at me from now on knowing that I'm into it?
: Can we still be friends? Am I in danger? What happens if those pictures aren’t enough for Sensei anymore? What if he comes after me next? Then what, Ami?
: Don’t hold back. I want to hear what’s on your mind. It’ll distract me from what’s going on in mine.
: Nothing will ever change the way I look at Sensei. But that...
: That’s a part of him I’ve kind of...known about for a really long time.
: I was the same when I was younger, Uta. Desperate to be wanted. To feel love. But the main difference between us is that my feelings were aimed at one person and yours were just...everywhere.
: So while you were sending pictures of yourself to people all over the Internet, I was touching myself in my uncle’s bed...hoping he’d wake up and have his way with me.
: Which one of us do you think is worse now?
: You were really cute back then. I don’t blame Sensei one bit for touching himself to your pictures. I’m just a little jealous, that’s all...
: Jealous?...
: Yeah...
: I’ve seen the way he looks at you...the way you look at him...and that makes me want to tie him up and do all of the things that you’re too afraid to.
: This isn’t really...how I thought things would go when I told you about-
: It’s hard to predict how things will go...What...wrong decision or...mistake we’ll make next...
: Even when you think you know how things are going to play out...one wrong turn and everything gets thrown into chaos.
: I don’t blame you for what you did back then...or how it impacted who you are today...
: Because the truth is, Uta...
: I think you’re perfect.
: That’s the kind of girl I think you are...
: You...
: N...No...I just told you all of those things about me. That’s...That isn’t perfect...It’s not even...close...
: There’s a reason Sensei looks at you as much as he does...and it’s so...so clear when I can see you up close like this...
: Ami...what’s going on?...
: What are you doing?...
: What do you want me to do?...
: You feel it too, don’t you?...
: I feel...a lot of things right now...but we haven’t really finished our conversation about...
: Are you sure?...I think we did...
: No...I need to know what you’ll do if...
: If what?...
: If...Sensei does something...when I confront him about this...
: You’re gonna confront him?...
: I can’t just...ignore this...I need to know...how he got them...
: Will you let him touch you if he asks?...
: Will...
: Will you hate me if I do?...
: Will you let me touch you if I ask?...
: You?...But...Wait a second...Hold on! Aren’t you straight?! Are you just messing with me right now?! You are, aren’t you?!
: Are you nervous?...
: Isn’t that obvious?! This isn’t how this conversation is supposed to go!
: I’m sorry...you’re just...
: So cute up close...
: Wha...
: Uta...
: Let’s be needy together...
: Let’s do for each other what he won’t do for us...
: I’ve gotta get back to work!
: Well...that might make things a little awkward.
: Oh, hey. How did your talk with Ami go?
: We almost kissed.
: Cool. We’ve got a party of seven coming in at-
: YOU WHAT?!
: Uta-chan’s powers...work against her again...
: You almost kissed?! How?!
: With our mouths, obviously!
: I know that, idiot! But what could have possibly happened in the five minutes you were in there that led to that?! Weren’t you just teaching her about parfaits?!
: I was teaching her about the long-term effects of trauma and how some nuts are easier to crack than others!
: We’re selling nuts now?!
: Can you two stop yelling?! We have customers in here!
: Uta almost broke the biggest rule of the cafe! And Ami definitely shouldn’t be allowed to work here anymore!
: Hi! Uhh...
: Bye.
: Oh my God. Did she look at me? I was looking away. Chika-chan! Did Ami look at-
: Get with the program, Uta-chan! We’ve got nuts to sell!
: Aaaaah!!!!! What just happened?!?!?!?!
Uta’s affection with Ami has...increased?
Meanwhile...wherever Sensei is...
